title: Synthetic repeated authentication failures
objective: Demonstrate non-overlapping correlation windows by identifying two separate bursts of failed authentication activity for the same account.
authorization_boundary: Synthetic authentication records only. No account, endpoint, or identity service is contacted.
expected_outcome: Two medium-severity detections, each backed by three failed events inside a ninety-second window.

rules.name: Repeated authentication failures
rules.description: Three failed authentication attempts for the same user and host occur inside ninety seconds.

response.description: Recommend reviewing the synthetic account and source context before taking any identity action.
